import bpy,json,hashlib,math,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parents[1];cap=root/'captures/shipyard_access_20261116';craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
assert not bpy.data.is_dirty
def digest(o):
 h=hashlib.sha256();h.update(np.array(o.matrix_world,dtype=np.float64).tobytes())
 if o.type=='MESH':
  for attr,size,prop in [(o.data.vertices,3,'co'),(o.data.loops,1,'vertex_index')]:
   a=np.empty(len(attr)*size,np.float64 if prop=='co' else np.int32);attr.foreach_get(prop,a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  for uv in o.data.uv_layers:
   a=np.empty(len(uv.data)*2,np.float32);uv.data.foreach_get('uv',a);h.update(a.tobytes())
  h.update(json.dumps([m.name if m else '' for m in o.data.materials]).encode())
 return h.hexdigest()
rows=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
 rows.append({'name':o.name,'min':[min(v[i] for v in pts) for i in range(3)],'max':[max(v[i] for v in pts) for i in range(3)],'hash':digest(o),'materials':[m.name for m in o.data.materials if m] if hasattr(o.data,'materials') else []})
